name: ShowroomTrafficUpsBoard
tagline: The dealership up system, floor traffic log and closing-ratio board in one Power Platform app.
description: Run a fair salesperson rotation, see who is waiting to be greeted, log every walk-in, move customers through test drive and write-up to sold, be-back or lost, and track closing ratio per salesperson and source – in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Up-system rotation with take up, skip, off floor and re-order
Stage rules with required fields (licence check, deal value, lost reason, follow-up)
Closing, demo-drive and write-up rates per salesperson
Bulk lost / reassign, CSV export, undo
